# tenzir_roles (Data Source)

The built-in and custom roles of an organization. Needs `Organization.listRoles`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_roles" "acme" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
}

output "custom_roles" {
  value = [for r in data.tenzir_roles.acme.roles : r.label if !r.builtin]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles, built-in ones first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the platform defines the role.
- `color` (String) The display color.
- `id` (String) The role ID, such as `org.admin` for a built-in role.
- `label` (String) The display name.
